Vauss for Windows (x64) - try it

1. Unzip anywhere, then double-click vauss.exe: your browser opens the scene picker (keep the black window open; close it to stop).
2. In the picker, paste a folder or .ply/.spz path, or upload a .ply/.spz file, then click Open.
3. Or from a terminal: vauss view <scene folder | run folder | file.ply>   (add --port 9000 to pick a port; it otherwise finds a free one)
4. In the room: drag furniture in from the drawer; "Generate" makes new objects and "Restyle" changes the time of day (both need a fal key in FAL_KEY).
